title: Notion Just Killed Its Email App. It's a Warning Shot for Every Other SaaS Tool.
angle: Notion's claim that 'AI agents replaced the inbox' isn't an excuse, it's a prophecy. This move signals the end of single-purpose apps and the rise of the AI agent as the primary interface for professional work.
rationale: This story translates a specific product shutdown into a massive, forward-looking trend that directly affects our professional audience.

source_articles.title: Notion killing Skiff-influenced email app since most users use AI agents instead
source_articles.excerpt: Notion is "going all in on using agents to run your inbox."
